name: Austerlitz
note: Austerlitz, 1805 (docs/plans/active/m8-austerlitz.md): a 6 km map (decision 0061) of the whole field as a scale model at 2× (decision 0070): 12 km of ČÚZK's terrain read into 6 km, its heights halved with it, so slopes and sight are the field's. From the highway in the north to Satschan in the south.

sources.ref: ČÚZK DMR 4G, 49.1325 N 16.745 E, a transverse Mercator centred there
Habsburg First Military Survey (Josephine), Moravia, 1764-1768, 1:28,800; WMS layer Military1 of Chartae Antiquae (VÚGTK and HÚ AV ČR)
sources.credit: © VÚGTK, v.v.i. & HÚ AV ČR, v.v.i.
sources.licence: none stated; watermarked; kept out of git (docs/research/period-maps.md)
sources.note: fetched with tools/scan-wms.ts over the relief file (49.1325 N 16.745 E, 15 km); control points at dated landmarks (Wikidata, CC0): the churches of Šlapanice, Tuřany, Prace and Telnice, the chapel of St Anthony, Sokolnice castle, Žatčany; each pixel read off the scan. The survey is off by about 560 m between them (each point where the others put it: docs/plans/active/m8-austerlitz.md)
